title: 2x Formamide Loading Dye
author: Haven Himmighoefer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ks8cwhw

steps.title: Prepare loading dye mixture
steps.instruction: In a 15 mL Falcon tube combine 9.5 mL Formamide, 330 µL deionized water, 50 µL 2 % Bromophenol Blue, 50 µL 1 % Xylene Cyanol, 50 µL 1 % Orange G, and 20 µL 0.5 M EDTA, then mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Aliquot and store
steps.instruction: Aliquot 1 mL of the mixture into individual Eppendorf tubes, label each tube “2x”, and store the tubes on the bottom shelf of the refrigerator.
